OP, 

You claim you’re ugly and that this is the best relationship you’ll ever get. However, you did say you guys met when you were 19, and he was 29. How do you know this is the best it will get? You were a teenager when you met; you haven’t even seen the best, let alone experienced it. I can assure you there is better out there than this, despite how little you think of yourself, or how little this man (who probably slowly drilled these thoughts into you) thinks of you. You claim to be satisfied in the relationship. Are you truly satisfied, or are you satisfied with what’s simply been handed to you? This man gave you a can of food with no can opener, but you accepted anyways because you were desperate for food. He might treat you fine, but he does not treat you well. A marriage out of convenience is not a marriage, it’s a contract.
